sections.text_helper: Section 72.2.6 "VBUS detection" in chapter 72 (USB subsystem (USBSS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3751.
sections.section_content:
OTGPHY1 is configured in VBUS external comparator mode. As a consequence:
• OTGDISABLE0 and DRVVBUS0 bits of OTG1PHYCTL_CR register must be kept to
their reset values.
• VBUSVLD and SESSVLD bits of OTG_GCCFG register must be ignored.
